verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's own docs say it can extract content from any URL as markdown, as an alternative to HTML or JSON. The GitHub README promises "Clean markdown" as LLM-ready output, and a parse endpoint also converts local HTML and other files to Markdown. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the markdown is cleaned (e.g. main-content filtering or boilerplate removal), independent hands-on corroboration of markdown quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as clean markdown instead of raw HTML

citations.quote: Extract content from any URL as markdown, HTML, or structured JSON
LLM-ready output: Clean markdown, structured JSON, screenshots, and more
Turn local PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, and more into Markdown or structured JSON
